contract.definition: currentOrderProduct:OrderProduct = self.CurrentOrderProduct, selectedItem:Item = Item.allInstances()->any(candidate:Item | candidate.Barcode = barcode)
contract.postcondition: let entry:OrderEntry in entry.oclIsNew() and OrderEntry.allInstances()->includes(entry) and entry.Item = selectedItem and entry.Quantity = quantity and entry.SubAmount = quantity * selectedItem.OrderPrice and currentOrderProduct.ContainedEntries->includes(entry) and result = true
